about_the_game:
This demo is currently being actively worked on! We're working our hardest to bring you the best Lover's Enigma experience to you, we thank you for being patient and hope you will enjoy the game!

In the demo, you'll experience the first four days of the story and interact with the main characters.

By the fourth day, the character with the highest affection will appear, leading to their route, though this branching will only be available in the full game. However, you'll still get a glimpse of what unfolds before that moment!

Be careful,  there are a few bad endings lurking, so watch your sanity~

You play as a woman in her late 20's, struggling with the responsibility of balancing the intricacies of your relationships and your own mental stability, whilst also seeking the truth behind the mysterious death of your husband. You must navigate through a web of secrets involving a mysterious cult, personal traumas, and complex relationships.

The Demo consists of the first 4 days of the story, allowing you to explore the world and meet the characters! 

In the demo, you will be able to meet the 4 male leads and interact with them!

HARUKI is the exorcist your Mom hired to help with your spiritual problems. He's eccentric and a little weird but he means well. For some reason his favourite food keeps changing. 

REN is your neighbour who you rarely see. But when you do, he's sarcastic and short tempered. You'd like to befriend him, but it's the equivalent of trying to befriend a chihuahua.

RYOTA is your childhood friend,  who was roped into a fake dating scheme to placate your overbearing mother—who, unsurprisingly, has always favored him over you. He's a little awkward at times but he does care for you in his own way.

KAZUKI is your husband who passed a few months ago. The official reports say he took his own life but you knew him the best. He wouldn't do something like that.., Would he?

Features for the main game include:

  • Various Storylines

  • Different endings to Unlock

  • Various CG's to collect

  • Rhythm Mini Game

In the demo, 

  • 8 CG's to be unlocked based on the different Male leads

  • 5 endings

  • Rhythm mini game

  • Side storylines

Thank you for your support and we hope you like the demo!

content_descriptors.notes:
"Koibito no Nazo" contains mature themes and content that may not be suitable for all audiences. Players should be aware of the following:

Violence: The game includes depictions of physical violence, including murder and psychological manipulation.

Self-Harm and Suicide: The storyline involves themes of self-harm and suicide, including a character who dies under suspicious circumstances that appear as a suicide.

Mental Health Issues: Themes of depression, anxiety, and PTSD are present, as characters cope with traumatic experiences and their aftermath.

Players who may be sensitive to these themes are advised to proceed with caution. Our aim is to handle these topics with care and respect while delivering a compelling and immersive experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD / Intel CPU (AMD Ryzen 3 1300x or Intel i7-930 or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD / NVIDIA dedicated graphics card, with 6GB of dedicated VRAM and Shader Model 6.0/6.1 support (i.e. AMD RX 580 8GB and NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or newer)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated DirectX 9 compatible soundcard

short_description: In Lover's Enigma , you investigate your husband's mysterious death while balancing complex relationships and personal trauma. Navigate a web of secrets involving a hidden cult and key characters. Your choices shape the story and lead to multiple endings.
